note: `topics` is required — a subscription to nothing would open a stream that can only ever send heartbeats.
Empty `topics` — minItems: 1, for the same reason.
`topics` outside the closed enum — each topic is bound to the read that authorizes it.
A per-group watch — additionalProperties: false catches `groupId`. The `groups` topic covers every group the caller may manage; a filter naming one would make the stream a per-record watch.
A per-room watch — additionalProperties: false catches `roomId`. The `communityRooms` topic covers every room the community owns; a filter naming one would make the stream a per-record watch.
`offers` is not a topic — admissions offered to members are part of the `communityRooms` topic, which is bound to the owner's reads.
`notes` is not a topic — administrators' notes are part of the `directory` topic, which is bound to the directory reads.
Unknown top-level member — a hint channel has no filter beyond topics; `memberDid` would make it a per-record watch.
`resumeToken` with a line break — the resume token travels as the SSE `id` field, which cannot contain one.
Response without `resumed` — the console could not tell whether it must re-read every topic.
Response with no effective topics — a caller who may read none of the requested topics is refused with permissionDenied rather than given a stream that is silent by construction.
`heartbeatSeconds` above 60 — a console waiting twice that long would show a dead stream as live for minutes.

`since` carrying a resume token — the 0.4 name; from 0.5 the request member is `resumeToken`, and `since` is reserved registry-wide for an RFC 3339 time filter. additionalProperties: false catches it.
